finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit code `0`, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw `TypeError`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated unset flags as invalid instead of `false`, since the new config loader leaves them `undefined`.

The rest was harmless deprecation noise from the bump, unchanged.
